parameters.text:
Tears make their way down your face, despite your efforts to stop them, and your parents, well-meaning as they are, even more so than your teacher, start trying to think of a different solution. 

They still seem unsure of what to think about all of this. You never *seemed* bullied to them. Billie was just one of your friends from school. Your recent change in behaviour greatly confuses them, but they will do what they can to help. Again.
